secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side admin operations. Not required to boot the app — needed by the push notification delivery route. Get it from your Supabase project settings (Settings → API → service_role).

secrets.name: SENDGRID_API_KEY
secrets.description: SendGrid API key used to send transactional email. Create one in SendGrid → Settings → API Keys (Mail Send permission).

secrets.name: NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: Verified SendGrid sender address used as the From address for notification email (for example notifications@yourdomain.com).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_RBM_AGENT_ID
secrets.description: RCS Business Messaging agent id (for example brand@yourdomain.com) from the Google RCS Business Messaging console. RCS also requires carrier/brand verification before messages deliver.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_RBM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
secrets.description: Full service-account JSON key (single line) for the RBM agent, granted the RCS Business Messaging scope.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: Public VAPID key for browser push. Generate a pair with `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys` and paste the public key here (it is exposed to the browser by design).

secrets.name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Private VAPID key paired with NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, used server-side to sign browser push messages.
